title: Maraudon
body: Maraudon lies beneath the Valley of Spears, the holy ground of the centaur, a tomb their people guard and only the most devout may enter. Its caverns run far down into the earth, and they are sick. Rot has spread through the upper caves: the water is poisoned, twisted vines choke the passages, satyrs move among them, and dryads tend the poisoned growth as though it were still a garden. Deeper down the stone itself is awake, and pale spirits of centaur drift through the dark.

title: Lord Vyletongue
body: Lord Vyletongue is a dark satyr, master of the Putridus who hold the Wicked Grotto, and the rot of Maraudon is his work. He spread his evil through its caves and poisoned the minds of all inside, and he treats the centaur's holy place as his own. He and the creature he made stole the two halves of a scepter that once gave its bearer power over the caverns.

parts.body: Noxxion, a great shape of poisoned water at the end of the Noxious Hollow, is Vyletongue's creation, a living symbol of his corruption.

title: Celebras the Cursed
body: Celebras the Cursed is a keeper of the grove, antlered and stag-bodied, who wanders a hollow beside the poisoned falls with dryads about him. Whatever he was before, the corruption of the caverns has him now. His sister waits in the Valley of Spears, begging for someone to help him.

parts.body: Freed of the curse, Celebras tells who he is: a son of Remulos, who came into these caves with his dryad sisters to free the tortured spirit of his uncle Zaetar, and fell to the corruption instead.
sources: creature 12225 single spawn on map 349 at 726,78 (WMO group 17071, unlabeled, beside Corrupt Force of Nature 13743 x3, Celebrian Dryad 11793 x2, Sister of Celebras 11794 x2); display 12350 KeeperOfTheGrove at scale 1.3

parts.body: Zaetar always felt he could not match his brother Remulos. Blinded by jealousy he set out to outdo him, and fell for a princess of elemental earth, though Remulos knew the union was cursed.

title: Princess Theradras
body: Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth, related somehow to the Old Gods, and she walks the green valley deep in Maraudon among giants of stone. Ages ago Zaetar, first son of Cenarius, sought her out, and their offspring are the centaur. The centaur killed Zaetar, and Theradras keeps his remains.

parts.body: When Theradras fell, a spirit rose in the valley, a towering keeper of the grove, crying that he was free of his bonds at last.

title: Zaetar's Spirit
body: Freed when Theradras fell, the spirit of Zaetar stands in the green valley where she walked, and he does not mean to leave it. The centaur are his misbegotten sons and daughters, he says, and they need their father. The valley rings with all that Cenarius preaches, and it sprang from him; he will not take that from them, not even for their crimes against him.

parts.body: Zaetar sent the first seed of the life his remains nourished to his brother Remulos. Remulos had thought him lost in his arrogance and anger, and found him reborn.

title: The Spirits of the Khans
body: Ghosts of centaur walk the caverns of Maraudon, great khans by their look, each bearing the title of a khan of old as though in a line of rulers long gone. They take no notice of the living and harm no one. Yet those who know the way can call them back into the world, and what is called back does not come in peace.

parts.body: A centaur pariah, exiled as a heretic, needs an outsider to enter the holy halls for him. His destiny, he says, is to unite the tribes of the centaur.
